summary.text: Ann Williams is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 11th District, serving since January 2011, according to the Illinois General Assembly.

paragraphs.text: Williams's legislature biography describes an attorney with a B.A. in journalism from the University of Iowa and a J.D. from Drake University.
It says Williams was formerly an assistant attorney general and legislative director for Attorney General Lisa Madigan, and lives in Chicago's West Lakeview neighborhood.
